howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动生成历史科学类3分钟科普短视频的全套素材，包括口播文案、分镜脚本、Veo2提示词和人物形象规范。
howto.when: 当你提供科普主题、年代背景和核心科学结论，并请求制作视频素材包时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成“蝴蝶效应的起源”视频素材包，年代1961年。
say.note: Claude 会调用脚本生成全套文件。

say.text: 制作青霉素发现的科普视频素材，年代1928年。
say.note: Claude 会输出文案、分镜等文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate a complete set of materials for a 3-minute popular science short video on historical science topics, including voiceover script, storyboard, Veo2 prompts, and character design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a science topic, historical era, and core conclusion, and request video material generation.

say_en.text: Generate video materials for 'The Origin of the Butterfly Effect', era 1961.
say_en.note: Claude will run the script to produce all files.

say_en.text: Create materials for a video about the discovery of penicillin, era 1928.
say_en.note: Claude will output script, storyboard, etc.
